Visitor modifies element at end after children processed

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	htmd "github.com/xberg-io/html-to-markdown/packages/go/v3"
)

type testVisitorVisitorElementEndModification struct {
	htmd.BaseVisitor
}

func (v *testVisitorVisitorElementEndModification) VisitElementEnd(ctx htmd.NodeContext, output string) htmd.VisitResult {
	return htmd.VisitResultCustom(`MODIFIED OUTPUT`)
}

func main() {
	options := htmd.ConversionOptions{}
	visitor := &testVisitorVisitorElementEndModification{}
	options.Visitor = visitor
	result, err := htmd.Convert(`<blockquote><p>Original quote</p></blockquote>`, &options)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Content)
}
```
